# Review protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What recall findings are reported in the supplied invented learning gardens records?

## Scope and inclusion criteria
Include both entirely invented records supplied in input.json, retaining their supplied claim/source pairs and synthesis wording exactly. The scope is the supplied synthetic corpus, with no population, date, language, or design restriction beyond membership in that corpus.

## Exclusion criteria
Exclude records not supplied in input.json. Do not add external literature, inferred findings, or replacement source passages.

## Authorization

Fulltext status refers only to completeness of the supplied synthetic text, not acquisition of a real publication. Notes document only that text.
